Home: Search and Script as moves one and two, search opens in place, more contrast

Items 4, 5 and 7. Your note: it just kind of blends in. I want it to be like one and two... they can do either of these and then pick. On search: search bar plus... suggestion chips, without a page change. On contrast: pretty plain, make it pop, a little bit of shade, more alive.

Item 3 (remove Profile from home): already done live. The 13 Nov home screenshot goes straight from "Hi Veejay" to the Connect TikTok banner and "What do you want to do?", with no Profile block. Nothing to design.

  • The two cards become solid teal blocks with white type, a large "1" and "2", and the only shadow on the page (your "little bit of shade"). Same copy as live.
  • The Search block shows the live field ("Product or #hashtag", red arrow) inside it, so it reads as a search box before you tap.
  • Tap: the block opens in place (0.22 s height change, no page change) into a focused field plus the live "Try" chips. The page scrolls the block to the top so the keyboard does not hide it.
  • Pushes down, not replaces. The Script block slides below the open search and stays visible. Replacing it would hide move two, and your point is that people pick either one. Close (X) or a search submit puts it back.
  • Contrast elsewhere: section headings at 22 px, and on the New Breakouts rows the views and "× usual" numbers go up to 17 px bold (multiplier in teal). Copy unchanged.

Items 1 and 2: saving scripts, and deleting things in Library

Item 1, your note: every script is saved, and it only shows a "Saved" label. I don't think that that's the best way. Where do they go? Item 2: how do we remove this (searches, analyses).

Live today (checked 13 Nov): scripts already auto-save. A script written without tapping anything shows in Library, Scripts tab, as "“Ever tried heatless curls? Let me show you how.”" with "heatless curls · 0:30 · 5 parts". The script page still ends in a red "Save script" button (plus Share and Copy) that does nothing new, because the script is already saved. That button is your point.

  • On the script page, the red "Save script" button goes, because there is nothing left to save. In its place, a quiet "Saved to Library" line with a check that opens Library on the Scripts tab, so it answers "where do they go?" right where the script is. Share and Copy stay exactly as live.
  • Library, Scripts tab is unchanged apart from delete (item 2). Rows keep the live format: hook, then idea, length and parts.
  • Delete on every Library list (Analyzed, Searches, Scripts) on phone: swipe a row left for a red Delete, or tap the "..." on the row for a sheet with Delete. On Saved, tapping the filled bookmark already on each tile removes it.
  • Desktop: a "..." on each row opens a small menu with Delete.
  • Undo toast, no confirm dialog. Deleting is a cleanup task people do several times in a row, and a dialog doubles the taps each time. The toast ("Search deleted", Undo) stays 6 seconds, so a slip costs one tap to reverse. The item is only removed for good once the toast is gone.
Live today: script page (phone)Already saved, but the main button still says "Save script"
Live today: Analyzed tabNo way to remove a row

Item 8: small motion touches so the app feels alive

Your note: UX/UI throughout the app to make it feel alive. Kept to motion that reports something real (a number arriving, a list changing). All ease out in 150 to 700 ms, nothing bounces or loops, and all of it turns off under the phone's Reduce Motion setting.

WhereWhat movesWhy
Breakout numbers (home rows, Top Breakouts, analysis)Views and "× usual" count up from 0 the first time a row shows, 600 ms, tabular figures so the width doesn't jitterThe size of the jump is the product. It is also the moment a creator screen-records for a TikTok
Search resultsThe "140 breakouts" count ticks up while cards arrive one after another, 50 ms apart, each a 220 ms fade with a 6 px riseTurns the wait into a reveal; reads well in a 9:16 recording
Home search blockOpens in place in 220 ms; chips fade in 40 ms apart; Script slides downItem 5. The eye stays on the same spot instead of jumping to a new page
Bookmark on a videoIcon fills in 120 ms, no scale-upClear "it worked" without a pop
Library deleteRow slides out left and the rows below close the gap in 180 ms; Undo slides it backShows exactly what went, and makes undo believable
Script being writtenHook, then each part, appears in order as it is written, instead of one spinner for the whole scriptProgress you can read; the first lines show up sooner

Item 9: Top Breakouts, mixing up a list where every card says 99

Your note: results always default to 99/100. How do we mix it up? One big list? Ideas wanted.

Why it happens: the list is sorted by Score, and Score tops out at 99, so the top of every category is a wall of 99s. Any fix has to sort by something that still varies at the top.

Data catch: on the live /b/ pages, "usual" currently equals the creator's follower count (29 of 30 sampled videos; I flagged it to Lester on 11 Nov). That is where values like 66,376× come from. So any option that ranks by "× usual" only works once that is fixed. Options B and C below work on today's data; A comes after the usual-views fix.

Live today99, 99, 99, each with the same big Score first
OptionWhat the user seesData it needsCatch
B. Sort by fastest rising (lead option, works on today's data)Today's cards, same layout and stats, ordered by views per day since posting. One added line per card says that number ("1.5M views a day"). A sort switch: Fastest rising (default), Newest, Most viewsViews, age in days. Both are on today's cardA video can rank high on a big account's normal day; that is what A fixes later
C. Category mix in "All" (works on today's data)"All" takes the top video from each category in turn (Beauty, Food, Home, Fashion, Fitness, Tech, then round two), plus one pick from a small account (under 10K followers) in every six. Cards unchangedCategory, followers, ScoreFixes sameness of topic, not the 99s. Pairs well with B
A. One big ranked list by size of the jump After the usual-views fixRank 1, 2, 3 down one list per category. Each row leads with "× usual" in big teal type, then views, likes, comments and shares; Score in small greyViews, the creator's real usual views, Score as a gateNeeds the usual-views fix, plus a floor on usual views so tiny accounts don't top the list. This is the "one big list" you asked about
B. Fastest rising, phone (lead option)Live videos and their live views, likes, comments, shares, followers and age. Views a day = views divided by days since posting
